_intro:
## Ready for fix sessions, in this order (checked by eye, 2026-11-02, kinds at noon and the first walkable cells)

1. **`shape` list below, one kit at a time.** The user's main ask. Checked at its top: `vendor-pretzel-cart` is a box on a plinth with two plain boxes on top, `prop-waterbutt` a 10-sided prism with a pie-slice lid, `veg-allotment-*` hexagon slabs, cones and paper-strip beans. Further down it's noisier: `feat-marketstall` ranks high for customers' hats, because the capture stands in the crowd. Read the "what" column before starting on a row.
2. **`glass-reflection-ghost-content`.** One system, on every shop window a walker passes, and it reads as broken: the reflection lies over the room in blocks and streaks, so a facade across the street shows as rows of dark squares on the shop's back wall, with a hard horizontal band through the room (`squares/c20_-110/12_W`, `squares/c0_-60/12_E`). Containers on a big pane smear into horizontal streaks (`squares/c80_-90/12_E`). These were shot 8° off, so it isn't the square-on fault.
3. **Car glass, listed as `vehicle-roof-open-top`. Corrected: the roof is there.** A stopped car from above has a whole roof (`shots/sweep-check/car-roof/sheet-5197.png`). From in front at eye level the roof is edge-on and the glass has almost no tint or reflection, so it reads as an open car (`objects/veh-mpv/12_1m`, `objects/bldback-apartment/12_10m`). The fix is the glass, not the roof. Lines where the cabin looks open from above with a floating bar (`objects/veh-brake-lights/12_10m`) are the camera inside a car, so ignore them.
4. **Town Hall windows, listed as `window-bars-offset-in-front-of-glass`.** On the most central building a thin black cross lies over each arched window. It ignores the white glazing bars and runs past the glass onto the frame (`squares/c0_0/12_E`, `squares/c20_0/12_N`, `squares/c20_-20/12_S`). Plain from across the street. The arched surrounds also have stepped, saw-tooth edges. Not traced; the windows come from `src/world/landmarks/facade.ts`, and the cross may not.
5. **Chimney smoke, `clouds-smoke-sprites`.** At noon the plumes are grey cotton-ball clumps with hard outlines, in a line in clear sky (`objects/life-smoke-vent/12_1m`). They also hang faint over the sea with no source in sight (`squares/c110_30/12_E`). The vents under them are bare grey cylinders. Shared with `src/sim/ambient.ts`.
6. **`fittings-floating-unattached` and `thin-structures-unattached`.** Real, each a small fix, so work down the lines in `sweep-tag-bug.md`: the SEAVIEW HOTEL sign's poles run in front of the letters (`objects/named-seaview-hotel-59/12_roof`), lantern rods come in slanted from above the frame and stop in front of windows (`squares/c10_-130/12_N`), the DIRECTORY board hangs in the air inside a shop (`objects/cs-text-tenants/12_1m`).
7. **`textures-smeared-stretched`.** Mixed, so split it. Wrong materials are the real part: wood grain on the stone arch ring of the road tunnel (`objects/feat-roadportal/12_3m`), whose lights are also plain slabs.
8. **`decals-cracks-stains-pasted` and `sky-specks-dots`.** Checked under the first brief: black squiggle cracks on plaster and rock, white dots at noon.
9. **`people-mannequin-stiff-blank`, `objects-interpenetrate-geometry`, `hands-miss-held-objects`.** Real, large. Close up, hair pokes through hats and arms are stiff (`objects/ped-hat-sunhat/12_1m`). The capture exaggerates it by standing in the crowd. Interpenetrate and hands: judges' lines, not opened.
10. **Small and plainly wrong, each its own fix, checked one picture each.** The estate agent's SOLD board is see-through: the garage door frame and the eave show through it (`objects/cs-text-agent/12_1m`, family `see-through-ghost-surfaces`). The advertising column's stone ribs cut through its posters, hiding letters, and a poster's star sticks out past the column's edge (`objects/cs-text-column/12_1m`, `sign-lettering-clipped`). A promenade bench and bin stand on the upper level with stilt legs running down the quay wall to the lower one, the sitter's feet in the air (`objects/area-promenade-paving/12_10m`, misfiled under `objects-no-contact-shadow`). A dentist's name on a transit depot's staff door (`objects/bld-depot-industrial-barrel-plain/12_3m`, `content-mismatch-signs`). A head with a hole through it, hair cap and skull not closed, seen from very near (`squares/c0_-60/12_E`, `people-head-hair-mesh-torn`).

11. **Second set, one or two pictures each.**
    - **Shaded streets read as dusk at noon, so `lighting-inconsistent-noon` is off HOLD.** A north-facing facade and its road look like evening (`squares/c20_-20/12_S`). This is the sky's ambient level and changes every picture, so compare it by eye before merging.
    - **Tree trunk with a collar, `tree-trunk-stacked-mismatch`.** A wide bark trunk stops partway up in a hard rim, and a narrower one with a dark strip carries on, so it reads as a snapped post (`squares/c-90_140/12_W`). First place to look: the near skin in `src/world/closenature/trunks.ts`. Not checked.
    - **Holes at the kerb, `paving-kerb-black-gap`.** A sharp dark wedge where paving and kerb don't meet (`squares/c-110_-30/12_down`), a black toothed strip along a kerb (`squares/c60_-70/12_N`).
    - **Pigeons, `animals-crude-blobs`.** Faceted, flat, fish-like, lying low on the paving (`objects/cs-ground-plaza/12_3m`). The plaza's dark paving bands in the same picture cut across the slabs instead of following the joints.
    - **Shore, `water-surface-flat`.** The wash is a smooth white roll with a dead-straight hard edge on the sand, and a row of reeds stands in the sea (`squares/c140_70/12_S`).
    - **Building-site stairs, `architectural-details-crude`.** Blue treads float with nothing carrying them, beside a plain black window hole (`objects/bldback-construction/12_3m`).
    - **Diagonal hatch on shaded walls.** Fine slanting scratches over brick and stone, in no family (`objects/bldback-construction/12_3m`, `squares/c60_0/12_N`, `squares/c20_0/12_N`). Not traced.
    - **Signal lenses, `traffic-signal-all-lit`.** Not all lit. From near, each lens is a flat pastel pie under its visor's shadow and the lit one is washed out, so all three read as on (`squares/c60_0/12_N`). Fine further off (`squares/c-60_-90/12_S`).

**Judges wrong, so leave these alone:** the reversed BUS STOP marking reads correctly for oncoming traffic (`squares/c70_-70/12_E`). The orange car over the zebra is a car turning, frozen (`squares/c30_90/12_E`). The lorry cab and box "fused" at `squares/c-130_100/12_N` is one lorry close to the camera. The tilted plank at `squares/c-60_-90/12_S` is a wheel stop, and it looks fine.

**Not opened by me:** `prop-count-misplaced`, `street-furniture-blocking` (a trunk fills the view of a shop door, `objects/bld-townhouse-oldtown-flat-shop/12_3m`, but its distance from the door isn't measured), and everything under `thought`. Open family by family: `lawn-grass-carpet-flat`, `signs-posters-flat-pasted`.

**Hold:** `shadow-bands-no-caster`, because the one I opened (`squares/c-30_-90/12_N`) looks like real shadows of the facade above. `lighting-inconsistent-noon`, because some of it is the capture in deep forest (`objects/rail-regional-cab-car-head/12_1m` is a view into dark trees, not the train). `glass-flat-no-depth`, `foliage-flat-cards`, `ground-surfaces-flat`: until more walkable cells are judged; only about a fifth are so far.

**Not the city:** `camera-misses-subject` and `camera-clips-into-geometry` rank near the top, and are the capture tool framing badly. They mean those kinds weren't really seen. `stray-debug-overlay-geometry` is at least partly the same: the white symbols by the gantry crane are a ship's load-line marks seen from inside its hull (`objects/feat-gantrycrane/12_10m`). A red see-through band across a whole street picture (`objects/ped-hair-bun/12_10m`) is something at the lens, not traced.

**White wall, open but lower:** it turns white in hard-edged rectangles only when the camera is level within about 1° and the wall within about 1° of square-on. At 3° down, none of 12 shots shows it, and the walker starts 3° down, so 207 m with real keys didn't show it on either build. A walker who tilts to level would. Sheet: `shots/sweep-check/white-pitch/kioskd-5197.png`. Reproduce: `__city.view({target:{x:-31,y:1.6,z:-136},distance:3,yaw:180,pitch:0})` at noon, or a level walk east along z = 108.25, where a facade flashes for one frame at x ≈ −35 (`shots/sweep-motion-level5197/motion/e00020.jpg`). Cause not found. The pictures judged here stand 8° off, which avoids it; the 1,519 shot square-on were deleted and shot again.
